title: Project name
description: Shown in the project list and Mesh2HRTF metadata. Changing it does not rename the folder.

title: Left ear
description: Input mesh for the left ear. You can use one ear or both.

title: Right ear
description: Input mesh for the right ear. You can use one ear or both.

title: Save location
description: Project folder for settings, copied inputs, intermediate files, simulations, and HRTFs. Referenced inputs stay in their original locations.

title: Use Mesh2PPM
description: Predict a PPM (parametric pinna model) mesh before preprocessing. Otherwise, use the selected ear mesh.

title: Model
description: Choose a pretrained model by number of views. Default: 3 views.

title: Evaluation grid
description: Directions where the sound field is evaluated. Leave empty to use the bundled grid.

title: Ear distance from head center
description: Move both ears inward or outward by the same amount; head size follows. Reference: about 75 mm per side, based on a study of 21 adults.

title: Min frequency
description: Lower limit of the simulated frequency range, in Hz.

title: Max frequency
description: Upper limit of the simulated frequency range, in Hz.

title: Frequency steps
description: Number of frequency samples across the range. Minimum: 2; default: 129.

title: Resample HRIRs
description: Resample HRIR (head-related impulse response) SOFA files after simulation. HRTF (head-related transfer function) SOFA files are unchanged. Off by default.

title: SOFA output folder
description: Project subfolder for SOFA (Spatially Oriented Format for Acoustics) files and plots. Leave empty to use HRTF.

title: Sampling rate
description: Target HRIR rate when resampling is on. Use a positive value divisible by 10 Hz. Default: 48,000 Hz.

title: Microphone faces
description: Number of nearby mesh faces defining the microphone region at the ear-canal entrance. Default: 6.

title: Min edge length
description: Smallest graded mesh edge, in mm. Smaller edges preserve more ear detail. Default: 0.5 mm.

title: Max edge length
description: Largest graded mesh edge, in mm, farther from the active ear. Default: 10 mm.

title: Max error
description: Maximum geometric remeshing error, in mm. Default: 0.5 mm.

title: Gamma
description: The grading factor used to estimate the active ear-canal entrance for mesh grading. The default is 0.2.

title: Gamma opposite
description: The grading factor used to estimate the contralateral ear-canal entrance while grading the active side. The default is 0.1.

title: Parallel instances
description: Maximum concurrent NumCalc jobs. More jobs may be faster but use more CPU and memory. Default: 1.

title: CPU limit (%)
description: Scheduler CPU-load threshold for starting another NumCalc job. Default: 90%.

title: Adaptive FMM expansion length
description: Adapt the fast multipole method (FMM) expansion length to cluster geometry. Enabled by default.

title: Apply level offset
description: Apply a fixed broadband gain to generated SOFA files. Directional spectral shape is unchanged.

title: Level offset
description: Broadband gain applied to SOFA files, in dB. Default: −30 dB.

title: Prepare ears from a head scan
description: Crop and prepare selected ears from an aligned head scan. You can edit the prepared meshes before preprocessing.

title: Full-head scan
description: Select an aligned head scan in millimetres. Prepared ears are saved in the project’s Prepared folder.

title: Crop rotation
description: Rotation around Z, in degrees, that sets the scan orientation for cropping. Align the scan with the nose tip and both ear-canal entrances in the app to set this to zero. Prepared ears use this crop frame (left +Y, right -Y).

title: Target edge
description: Target remeshing edge length, in mm. Default: 0.75 mm. Scan holes are closed using Screened Poisson reconstruction; one attachment boundary per ear is preserved.

title: Left crop margin
description: Margin around the left ear crop, in mm. Default: 20 mm.

title: Right crop margin
description: Margin around the right ear crop, in mm. Default: 10 mm.

title: Inner crop limit
description: Inner lateral crop distance before adding the margin, in mm. Default: 30 mm.

title: Outer crop limit
description: Outer lateral crop distance before adding the margin, in mm. Default: 110 mm.

title: Spatial HRTF upsampling
description: Create more source directions by interpolating minimum-phase HRIRs with vector-base amplitude weights and restoring fitted arrival times. Sampling rate and HRIR length stay the same. Higher levels take more time and space; default: 3. Original exports are kept; results go in Upsampled.

title: Normalize to frontal reference
description: Scale using the frontal (0°, 0°) response as a −40 dB reference. Independent of the level offset. Turn off to preserve input levels.

title: MATLAB executable
description: Legacy setting retained for compatibility. Python upsampling does not use MATLAB.

title: Auditory Modeling Toolbox folder
description: Legacy setting retained for compatibility. Python upsampling does not use AMT.
